pages.name: Home
pages.notes: Single-scroll marketing page (Hero/Problem/HowItWorks/Features/ProductSection/Trust/FinalCta). No separate Product/Solutions/Pricing/Docs/Security/Contact routes exist.

pages.name: SignIn
pages.notes: Guest-only (RequireAuth redirects signed-in users to /app).

pages.name: SignUp
pages.notes: No password-recovery route exists anywhere in the app.

pages.name: CollectorSandboxDemo
pages.notes: Wave 30. Clearly labeled SANDBOX/TEST. Unauthenticated, outside /app shell and outside the tenant nav entirely -- reachable only by direct URL. No developer-facing link points to it from /app/api.

pages.name: Onboarding
pages.notes: Reached only via RequireTenant's needs-tenant redirect. No direct test renders this route.

pages.name: AppIndexRedirect
pages.notes: Pure redirect, no page content of its own.

pages.name: Overview
pages.notes: Audit-log widget is real; risk/assessment metrics and charts are sample-mode only (no GET /assessments exists).

pages.name: Assessments
pages.notes: No GET /assessments (list) endpoint exists anywhere in fraud-platform-api -- POST /api/v1/assessments is write-only/synchronous. Honestly gated behind UnavailableState + opt-in sample mode. NOT tagged 'soon' in app-nav-links.ts despite having no live backend, unlike Analytics/Transactions/Cases -- an inconsistency, not a defect.

pages.name: SampleAssessmentDetail
pages.notes: Explicitly sample-only by its own docstring: 'There is no GET /assessments/{id} in the platform API.' Real assessments can only be inspected via Decision Trace (paste).

pages.name: Transactions
pages.notes: Explicit UnavailableState: 'The platform API doesn't provide a way to list or search transactions.' Tagged soon:true in nav.

pages.name: Signals
pages.notes: Static reference catalogue (src/data/fraud-detect/signals.ts) of SUPPLIED_SIGNALS/DERIVED_SIGNALS -- product documentation, not tenant-specific data. No live API. Not tagged soon.

pages.name: Rules
pages.notes: Static F1-F10 rule catalogue (src/data/fraud-detect/catalogue.ts) -- no rule-configuration API exists in fraud-platform-api or fraud-engine's own tenant-facing surface. Not tagged soon.

pages.name: Cases
pages.notes: Explicitly named PLANNED_STATES/PLANNED_PANELS in source. No case-management backend exists anywhere. Tagged soon:true.

pages.name: DecisionTracePage
tests: src/test/fraud-ui.test.tsx (DecisionTrace/AssessmentDetail components only, not the page route itself)
pages.notes: Paste-based tool: the tenant pastes a REAL POST /api/v1/assessments response and the page renders it with parseAssessmentResponse(). No live fetch exists because no GET /assessments/{id} endpoint exists -- this is the correct, deliberate workaround, not a gap. No dedicated page-route-level test exists (only the underlying component is tested).

pages.name: Policies
pages.notes: MAJOR FINDING: no /api/policies route exists anywhere in fraud-platform-api (grepped: find app/api -iname '*polic*' returns nothing). TenantPolicyService/TenantPolicyVersion/draft-activate-retire lifecycle exists ONLY as internal service-layer code exercised by tests (tests/policy_support.py) -- there is no HTTP surface for it at all, for any client. This page is necessarily conceptual/static; it cannot become 'partial' without new backend work first.

pages.name: Analytics
pages.notes: Sample-mode only (same UnavailableState/SampleToggle pattern as Assessments). Tagged soon:true.

pages.name: ApiPage
pages.notes: Real credentials table + static request/response documentation, explicitly labeled 'Examples only'. GAP: documents ONLY POST /assessments and POST /context-events -- the collector API (POST /api/v1/collector/tokens, POST /collector/v1/collect), fully built since Wave 28D, has ZERO developer-facing documentation anywhere in this dashboard. No dedicated page-route test exists.

pages.name: Credentials
permissions: admin (mutating actions only; list is open to member)
pages.notes: Fully functional: list/create/rotate/revoke, reveal-once secret dialog (never re-fetchable, matching backend), client-side role gating that mirrors the backend's own require_role(OWNER, ADMIN) enforcement (defense-in-depth, not the sole boundary). Environment column will only ever show 'sandbox' -- create_sandbox_credential is the only issuance path; live is not issuable via any UI or public API.

pages.name: AuditLogs
pages.notes: Open to any authenticated member role (no require_role on this route).

pages.name: Settings
pages.notes: Organization info + read-only team-member list (explicitly labeled read-only: 'Inviting or changing members isn't supported by the platform API yet') + the signed-in user's own profile. No environment-settings section, no tenant-settings mutation (no PATCH /tenants/current endpoint exists).

pages.name: NotFound
pages.notes: Standard 404 catch-all.

missing_pages.name: Pricing
missing_pages.notes: No backend dependency at all; purely a marketing/business decision.

missing_pages.name: Docs
missing_pages.notes: Would document the real, existing API contract (assessments, context-events, collector) -- the collector API in particular has no documentation anywhere today (see /app/api notes).

missing_pages.name: Legal/Privacy/Terms
missing_pages.notes: No backend dependency; a product/legal decision, not an engineering blocker.

missing_pages.name: Password recovery
missing_pages.notes: No backend support exists for it either (no password-reset endpoint in fraud-platform-api) -- a genuine product gap, not merely a missing page.

missing_pages.name: Collector setup / sandbox integration surface
missing_pages.notes: The collector capability (token issuance, activation switches, rate limiting, CORS) is fully built and PostgreSQL-verified (Waves 28-31), but has NO representation anywhere inside the authenticated /app shell -- the only existing surface is the unauthenticated, nav-external /sandbox/collector demo page from Wave 30. A tenant using this dashboard today has no way to discover the collector exists at all.

missing_pages.name: Any Platform Admin page
missing_pages.notes: No platform-admin role, permission, or API exists anywhere in fraud-platform-api (grepped: no 'platform-admin', 'admin role' beyond the per-tenant OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER roles, no tenant-management-across-tenants endpoint). Building any Platform Admin UI now would require inventing backend capability this wave explicitly forbids inventing.

orphaned_backend_capabilities.classification: NOT APPROPRIATE FOR UI YET -- no HTTP route exists at all, for any client
orphaned_backend_capabilities.notes: Exercised only by tests/policy_support.py. Building a UI for this requires a new backend API first -- out of scope for an audit wave.

orphaned_backend_capabilities.capability: Collector token issuance / ingestion / activation / rate limiting
orphaned_backend_capabilities.notes: A real, production-grade, PostgreSQL-verified API exists (Waves 28-31) with zero tenant-facing representation inside /app.
assessment-api-v1.md section 9 explicitly withholds this from the public response -- no UI should surface it either, per the same contract.
Rotate/revoke actions themselves are in the Credentials UI; the resulting audit rows are only visible generically via /app/audit-logs, not cross-referenced from the Credentials page itself.
